landed.dedicated_model_assessment: Potentially viable with 8,740 rows, but requires treatment of multi-unit/portfolio sales, extreme luxury transactions, generic project labels, and high-cardinality streets.

private.assessment: Not broad private-residential coverage: 117 rows, five projects/streets, four districts, and 110/117 records are condominiums; one project supplies 87/117 rows. Do not train a general private condo/apartment model from this file.

ambiguities: HDB has no postal code and uses abbreviated/historical street names; 24 of 595 transaction street names are absent from the supplied street reference after simple case normalization.
URA supplies postal district, not full postal code or unit/block number; project/street pairs can span multiple buildings.
Landed Project Name is generic for 2,834 rows ('LANDED HOUSING DEVELOPMENT'), so Street Name is the stronger geocoding key; street names alone may still cover many house numbers.
No source contains latitude/longitude. Geocoding should create a cached property lookup later, without altering raw files.

private.warning: Too few and too narrowly clustered records for a stable general model or reliable holdout evaluation.
